title: Generated room calendars: can the requested booking be confirmed as it stands?
decision: whether one requested room booking can be confirmed unchanged, given the rooms, the written booking rules and the confirmed bookings (yes), or breaks one of the rules (no)

source.name: generator build/gen_sched_conflict.py
source.version: gen_v4, 2026-10-08: the planted rule is mostly a booking-list check (levels 2 / 3: 70 / 85 % overlap + person, was 40 %); hours, seats and equipment are decoys exactly at their limit in both members; level-3 overlaps mostly inside the reset gap of the room kind, decisive bookings mostly repeating with the request day not listed first

licence: generated by the benchmark's script (no third-party text)
skill: check one booking request against a room calendar: interval arithmetic with reset gaps, opening hours, seat counts, equipment lists and the other meetings of every attendee
knobs: level 1-3: rooms 2 / 3-4 / 5-6, booking lines 6-8 / 12-16 / 20-28, days 1 / 1 / 2-3, rules 3 / 5 / 5, reset gap none / one value / by kind of room, request as start-end / start + duration, repeating bookings only at level 3, attendees 2-4 / 3-6 / 5-8; near miss of 5, 10 or 15 minutes, one seat, one item, one person; planted rule per level (negatives) overlap / person / hours / seats / equipment: 34 / 0 / 33 / 33 / 0, 35 / 35 / 10 / 10 / 10, 43 / 42 / 5 / 5 / 5
notes: 600 items = 300 contrast pairs (group): the same state with ONE field changed (meta.field: a time of the request, one attendee name, the seat number, an opening or closing time, one equipment word); the positive sits exactly on the limit that the negative crosses. Every convention is written in the state; meta.spec holds the structured specification, meta.evidence what the request breaks, meta.features the near-limit situations and decoys. Item accuracy is the metric; the group allows a pair analysis. State length 1276 to 5916 characters. gen_v4 fix: reviewers found level 2 / 3 items decided by one cheap sum (start + duration beyond closing time, seat count); the planted rule is now mostly overlap (reset gap of the room kind) or person (other room), hours / seats / equipment are 15 % of the negatives at level 3 and 30 % at level 2 and sit exactly at their limit in the other items.
